brief.aim: The table is evidently assembled for classifying dry bean varieties: a single nominal outcome Class with seven labels and sixteen purely geometric predictors (area, perimeter, axis lengths, shape factors). This is a multiclass classification task, and no predictor is a component, recoding, or post-outcome measurement of the class label.
brief.repeated_subjects: No repeated-subject structure; each row is a distinct bean with unique geometric measurements.
brief.unit: One dry bean seed (individual bean instance) described by geometric shape measurements
